metadata.description: Audit first, Deny once the compliance pass is clean. Assigning Deny at subscription scope without an Audit pass is how you break deployment pipelines you did not know existed. Controls referenced: NERC CIP-005-7 R1 (Electronic Security Perimeter), NERC CIP-011-3 R1 (Information Protection), NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 SC-7 (Boundary Protection), AC-17 (Remote Access).
